summary: RunIter::nth can return Some instead of None for an oversized index because its skipping loop narrows a full interval's length to u16, losing the skip. The fix exhausts the iterator, resets its offsets, and returns None when n exceeds u16::MAX. The regression test added by this commit exercises this behavior after advance_back_to. The proposed reversal removes only that guard; both source regions are unique and match the original Git objects. No tests were executed.
